data.long_meaning: Ravind is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ravi', meaning Sun. This name is also associated with intelligence and courage. The name Ravind carries the meaning “Sun, Intelligent, Brave” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ravind usually hope their child will grow to embody sun, intelligent, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
